clue.text: Clearly annoyed despite support

definitions.meaning: someone with their ... is visibly irritated, from the idiom of getting one's ...
reserve help or a standby, as in calling for extra assistance

explanation.surface: Someone visibly irritated who nonetheless offers support.
explanation.definitionFit: Having your back up is an idiom for being visibly irritated; a backup is reserve help.

clue.text: Flourish and make pounds in economic upswing

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the pounds go within the upswing

parts.note: a boom is a period of fast economic growth
L is the abbreviation for pounds sterling, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: The economy flourishes and money is made in an upturn.
explanation.definitionFit: To bloom is to thrive or blossom, as flowers do.

clue.text: One abducting genetic material found in smoked herring

indicators.note: found in means placed inside, so the genetic material sits within the fish

parts.note: a kipper is a split, smoked herring
DNA is the molecule carrying genetic information

explanation.surface: A forensic scientist finds a suspect's DNA on a kipper.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who seizes and carries off a person, typically for ransom.

clue.text: Leave-permit to leave Sandhurst

definitions.meaning: a ticket letting you leave and return, as at a theatre
to graduate from a military college; Sandhurst is the British Army's officer academy

explanation.surface: An officer cadet gets a pass on graduating from military college.
explanation.walkthrough: Sandhurst is the Royal Military Academy where British Army officers train; cadets graduate at a parade.
explanation.definitionFit: A pass-out is a readmission ticket; passing out is graduating from military training.

clue.text: Associate team has a chance to score

parts.note: a side is a sports team
a kick, such as a penalty or free kick, gives a chance to score

explanation.surface: A football team member is given a chance at goal.
explanation.definitionFit: A partner or right-hand helper who accompanies a principal figure.

clue.text: Easy to discover where the hospital visitor is hurrying

definitions.text: where the hospital visitor is hurrying
definitions.meaning: a visitor heads directly to the patient's room, going without delay to the ward

explanation.surface: A visitor rushes straight to see a patient in hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition splits into three words: going directly, for, ward.
explanation.definitionFit: Uncomplicated and simple; also, read as three words, heading directly towards a hospital room.

clue.text: Relegated Dexter after public protest

indicators.note: after means the cricketer's name follows the protest in the answer

parts.note: a demo is a public demonstration
Ted Dexter was an England cricket captain

explanation.surface: A cricketer is dropped after a public outcry.
explanation.walkthrough: Ted Dexter captained England at cricket in the 1960s.
explanation.definitionFit: Moved down to a lower rank or division.

clue.text: Divided as to where Tom Sawyer can be found

definitions.text: where Tom Sawyer can be found
definitions.meaning: Tom Sawyer is a character created by Mark Twain, so he is found within that author's work

explanation.surface: Asking where a famous fictional boy lives.
explanation.definitionFit: Split into two is an archaic phrase; Tom Sawyer lives within the novels of the author Mark Twain.

clue.text: Think, dear, about compassion

indicators.note: about means turned round or moved around, so the letters of think dear are rearranged

explanation.surface: Asking a loved one to reflect on mercy.
explanation.definitionFit: A kind heart is a sympathetic nature, warmth towards others.

clue.text: Organic compounds found when bull dies in agony

parts.note: an ox is a bovine animal like a bull

indicators.note: a body in agony writhes, so the letters of the word dies are contorted into a new order

explanation.surface: Chemicals are produced as a bull expires in pain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in agony' rearranges the letters of 'dies' to give IDES, placed after the bull. Oxides are mostly inorganic, so the definition is loose.
explanation.definitionFit: Compounds of oxygen with another element, which the setter loosely calls organic.

clue.text: Butter served with unusual Bantu fruit

parts.note: something that butts, as a ram does with its horns

indicators.note: unusual here asks for the word Bantu to be put into an unusual order

explanation.surface: Butter is served alongside an exotic African fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Butter' is not the dairy spread but one who butts: a RAM. 'unusual' rearranges BANTU into BUTAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A rambutan is a hairy red tropical fruit from Southeast Asia, related to the lychee.

clue.text: Cairo man cooked pasta

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters of Cairo man are prepared and mixed into a new dish

explanation.surface: An Egyptian chef prepared a pasta dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Macaroni is a type of short tube-shaped Italian noodle.

clue.text: Henry invested in junk to flog

indicators.note: invested in means placed inside, so one piece goes into the other here

parts.note: trash means rubbish or junk
H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: Henry put money into junk bonds so he could sell them off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flog' means sell in British slang, but here it means beat. H is the SI symbol for the henry.
explanation.definitionFit: To beat or whip someone hard, or to defeat soundly.

clue.text: Military communique requires speed

definitions.meaning: an official report sent from the front line
promptness or haste, as in acting with all due haste

explanation.surface: An army message demands haste.
explanation.definitionFit: A dispatch is an official report from a war correspondent or officer; to do something with dispatch is to do it quickly.

clue.text: Ruthless self-interest results in canine cannibalism

definitions.meaning: fierce competition where everyone looks after themselves
read literally, one hound devouring another

explanation.surface: Selfishness leads to animals devouring their own kind.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes cut-throat competition, and literally depicts one hound eating another.

clue.text: Right to get retired woman as chaperone

parts.note: what is due to you is your right

indicators.note: retired means withdrawn or going back, so the woman's name is read backwards

parts.note: Ann is a common woman's name

explanation.surface: A pensioner is entitled to act as escort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Right' as a noun: what you are entitled to is your due. 'retired' turns the woman's name backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A duenna is an older woman who supervises a young lady, especially in Spain.

clue.text: The piano I repaired for an African

indicators.note: repaired suggests the letters of the piano I are fixed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A man boasts of mending a piano for a visitor from Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Ethiopia, a country in the Horn of Africa.

clue.text: Attic where fish has to soak

parts.note: the gar is a long-snouted fish
to ret is to soak flax or hemp to soften it

explanation.surface: A fish is left to soak up in the loft.
explanation.walkthrough: RET is a technical word for soaking flax or hemp so the fibres separate.
explanation.definitionFit: A garret is a small room under the roof of a house, a loft.

clue.text: Deflect light umpire before gunners get caught

parts.note: a ref is a referee or umpire
RA is the Royal Artillery, the gunners of the British Army
ct is a cricket scorecard abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: An umpire watches the bowlers being caught out by a light deflection.
explanation.walkthrough: RA, the Royal Artillery, are known as the gunners; CT abbreviates caught on some cricket scorecards.
explanation.definitionFit: To bend a ray as it passes from one medium into another, as water does.

clue.text: Drum acquired by a doctor during excursion

indicators.note: during means within the time of, so a doctor is placed inside the trip

parts.note: a tour is a trip or excursion
MB is a Bachelor of Medicine, a medical degree

explanation.surface: A drum is bought by a medic on holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a crossword stand-in for a doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: A tambour is a small drum, and also an embroidery frame.

clue.text: Abbreviated in favour of Kasparov's challenger

parts.note: being for something means supporting it
Nigel Short challenged Garry Kasparov for the world chess title in 1993

explanation.surface: Supporting the player who challenged the chess champion.
explanation.walkthrough: Nigel Short, an English grandmaster, played Kasparov for the world chess title in 1993.
explanation.definitionFit: Used of a shortened name: Tom is used in place of Thomas as an abbreviation.

clue.text: A pig of a driver

parts.note: a selfish motorist behaving like a swine, taking up the whole carriageway

explanation.definitionFit: A selfish motorist who drives without regard for others, taking more than their share of the highway.

clue.text: Declare that it's a fine company

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencil leads
a firm is a business or company

explanation.surface: Stating that a business is in good health.
explanation.definitionFit: To state something positively and with conviction.

clue.text: Peruse the details about a Channel port

parts.note: re means about or concerning
Dover is the English port on the Strait of Dover, the narrowest part of the English Channel

explanation.surface: Studying the particulars of a cross-Channel harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: To look through a text carefully from start to finish, checking it.

clue.text: A revolutionary device

parts.note: not a political rebel's bomb but a machine part that spins round

explanation.definitionFit: A rotating part of a machine, such as the blades of a helicopter.

clue.text: So rapid a scattering of people

definitions.text: So rapid a scattering of people

indicators.note: scattering spreads the letters of so rapid a about into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A people dispersed with great speed.
explanation.definitionFit: A diaspora is the dispersal of a population from its homeland, as with the Jewish people.

clue.text: Hard to get rowing crew to the peak

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
an eight is a racing boat with eight oarsmen

explanation.surface: A tough effort to bring the rowers to the top of their form.
explanation.walkthrough: An eight is the standard name for a rowing crew of eight oarsmen.
explanation.definitionFit: The highest point or summit, as in the height of summer.

clue.text: Dress and become exhausted

definitions.meaning: to put clothes on, from tire, an old word for attire
to grow weary and worn out

explanation.surface: Putting on clothes and growing weary.
explanation.definitionFit: Tire is an archaic form of attire, so getting attired is dressing; to tire is also to weary.

clue.text: Look for a bird

definitions.meaning: having a ... is British slang for taking a quick look

explanation.surface: Searching for a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking a gander means having a quick glance in British slang; the word is also a male goose.
